dog.description_text: My foster writes: Hi! I'm Sable! I'm a beautiful, very shy girl but becoming sweeter and sweeter by the day! My history is a mystery, but I don't seem to have had a lot of human contact prior to my being fostered! I at first was too scared to be around humans, but now when my foster parents are in bed but not asleep yet, I immediately jump up for pets! I love chin scratches and head scratches! I occasionally give love bites but never bit down! I love "making biscuits" on my foster parents too and especially cute doing this when I start chewing on the comforter a little! My foster parents are very impressed with the progress I've made in just a few months, and with more patience and understanding, am getting more comfortable and happy to be with humans every day!
dog.name: Sable
